tool-compaction: Bodies became indexes; this is not a count of missing chats. Use Raw to verify results.
excerpt-truncation: Text outside the excerpt is unverified; absence in an excerpt is not evidence of absence.
raw-character-limit: Some requested original text was not retrieved; affected claims need verification.
raw-request-limit: Some requested checks were deferred when selecting original records.
normalization-failure: Ambiguous events were excluded from review input.
invalid-log-lines: Content of invalid lines could not be read.
missing-review: Available lower-level sources supplied fallback evidence.
raw-unavailable: Retrieval or verification failed; original wording remains unchecked.
missing-catalog: Normalized chats for that source were not available.
other: See coverage.gaps in JSON for the recorded details.
uncitable-evidence: Lower-review items supported only by administrative events were excluded.
